# RichTextEdit

**Class:** `UltraCanvasRichTextEdit` · **Group:** [Text entry](../Groups/Text-entry.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A **formatted document** edited as it looks — fonts, sizes, colours, headings, lists, tables, images ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasRichTextEdit](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.md)
- [WordProcessingFeatureCoverage](../../UltraCanvas/WordProcessingFeatureCoverage.md)
- [UltraCanvasHTMLReader](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasHTMLReader.md)
- [UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator.md)
- [UltraCanvasFontFile](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasFontFile.md)
- [UltraCanvasTextFormatBar](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTextFormatBar.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRichTextEdit> CreateRichTextEdit( const std::string& name, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasRichTextEdit(const std::string& name, float x, float y, float width, float height);
UltraCanvasRichTextEdit(const std::string& name, float width, float height);
explicit UltraCanvasRichTextEdit(const std::string& name);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### enum `ZoomFit`

Zoom that follows the element's size, as a word processor's "Page width" and "Whole page": the page (with the desk either side) fills the width, or the whole page fits in the view. It is worked out again whenever the element is resized; SetZoom, Ctrl+wheel and Off end it. Only page view has a page to fit; outside it the zoom stays as it is.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Off` |  |
| `PageWidth` |  |
| `WholePage` |  |

### struct `FontReport`

What this computer lacks to show the document as it was written: the font families its text names that are not installed (drawn in a substitute), and the scripts no font covers at all (drawn as boxes of hex digits), each with a free font that covers it and the page it is downloaded from. The headers, footers, notes and table cells count; pictures and formulas do not. Worked out when a document is set, after edits (at most once a second) and when the fonts change - a font registered or installed, Windows' fonts arriving after a cold start.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `missingFamilies` | `std::vector<std::string> missingFamilies` |  |
| `missingScripts` | `std::vector<MissingScriptFont> missingScripts` |  |
